name: Some of You May Die
description:
About This Game

Some of You May Die is a strategic autobattler where you assemble a team of heroes and upgrade them to absurd levels of power.  Test your skill against other players in Online PvP!

Breaking the game IS the game.  Stack upgrades and heroes to level them up.  Invest gold in customizing your heroes with full control over their stat sheet.

Want a high armor priest who reflects incoming damage? You can do that.
How about an assassin with lightning fast movement speed who skips your opponents defensive line entirely? Yup.

No two heroes are the same! Every time you are offered a hero, they come with a different combination of Boosted Stats and an Ability that give them a unique edge.  These combinations create a huge amount of variety.  After choosing a hero, you are offered dozens of highly synergistic upgrades to push the customization even farther.  This empowers you to create ultra-powerful teams that feel completely unstoppable - until your opponent reaches for the perfect counter.

Key Features

  • Realtime & Async Multiplayer: Face other players and put your strategies to the test.  Matches are full of clever counters so it's never to late to stage a come-back!  You can choose between Realtime Multiplayer or Asynchronous Multiplayer so you never have to wait for matches.

  • A Constantly Shifting Meta-Game: Each match has a different pool of upgrades a randomized squad of heroes to pick from. This keeps the meta-strategy fresh every time you play!

  • Deep Customization: Each hero comes with 2 Boosted Stats (like health, attack speed, or range) and an ability.  Boosted Stats start higher and upgrade faster than a non-boosted stat. This means that each hero offered in the shop has unique potential and some can be upgraded to absurd levels of power.

  • Become Overpowered: Stack heroes of the same kind from the shop to level them up. Leveled heroes get a significant boost to their stats, making each level a meaningful step up.  Invest heavily in one or two powerful heroes or go wide and flood the battlefield to outnumber your foes!  The choice is yours.

  • Stack your Upgrades: Level up your heroes' upgrades too!  Upgrades offer a high variety of customization.  Some add effects to your heroes' attacks like Poison or Stun.  Some trigger actions on events like "on death" or "on kill".  Leveled upgrades become significantly more powerful which leads to highly strategic and specialized builds.

    Matches are tactical, full of wild synergies, and will have you on the edge of your seat right up to the end!
short_desc: Some of You May Die is a strategic autobattler where you can upgrade everything! Go head to head with other players in online PvP where clever tactics and cunning plans make the difference between victory or defeat!
